visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot shows a hand holding a yellow and blue can of WD-40. The hand wears a black smartwatch. In the background, a messy wooden desk with various items, including a small clear bottle and tissues, is visible. (2) The hand attaches a thin red straw to the nozzle and sprays white foam onto a black matte laptop lid which has sticky residue and a black stain on it. (3) The person uses a crumpled white paper towel to vigorously wipe the white foam in circular motions across the surface of the black laptop. The background remains consistent with indoor desk clutter. (4) The hand sprays a second, smaller amount of foam onto a specific stubborn spot on the laptop. The wiping continues with the paper towel, gradually revealing the silver Apple logo as the residue is lifted. (5) The surface is buffed clean, appearing smooth and reflective. The hands perform a final wipe to ensure all residue and moisture are gone, leaving the black surface looking restored.

(2) Constant mid-frequency friction noise begins, indicating a tissue rubbing against a hard surface. The acoustic guitar BGM remains consistent in the background. (3) A second, shorter aerosol spray burst is heard, cutting through the music momentarily. The rhythmic wiping sounds resume with varying intensity. (4) A soft, melodic female voice enters the mix, singing English lyrics. The arrangement expands to include light percussion (a simple kick and snare pattern). Wiping sounds persist as a rhythmic layer under the music until the tracks fade out.
